content: Yodakale eŋ Yokahaŋ Mede
Nu Pol, Kilisto Jesu’walaŋ mede yohautalat doktiŋa yot fafaŋeniŋ gineŋ hatat. Nukut notnik Timoti, indi tubuloda menik Filemon gabukahile hinek tamut, dutok pepa i youkamamut.

Indi pepa i witnik Apiyadok maaŋ youlimiyamut, eŋ Akipa, indigut mikme hatiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋ kwanaiŋiŋ gineŋ mikneyam aditok maaŋ youlimiyamut, eŋ metam du yokeneŋ bopneŋ Bepaŋ niutumbaiŋ aditok maaŋgoŋ youyemamut.
Betnik Bepaŋ tiŋa Wapumnik Jesu Kilisto adi’walaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋ eŋ kulemadi hidi’walaŋkade haliwooŋ hatuwaak.
Pol adi Filemon’walaŋ titiŋŋiŋ momooŋ doktiŋa Bepaŋ niutumbaguk
Nu helemahelemaŋ ninadine gineŋ welemomooŋ dutok nadiŋa Bepaŋne niutumbalat.
Maŋgoŋde, metamdi indiŋ naniiŋ, du Bepaŋ’walaŋ metam welegedi hinek yabukahilelaŋ eŋ Wapum Jesu nadisukilitimiŋa medeŋiŋ kelelaŋ. Adi unduŋ nanimbune nadilat doktiŋa Bepaŋ niutumbalat.
Tiŋa du nadisukiliti gineŋ indigut welekubugoŋ tilaŋ, doktiŋa nemek momooŋ Kilisto’walaaniŋ mintanimguk hatak u hogohogok nadidakaleweŋ yoŋa ninadilat.
Notne, du welegedi Bepaŋ’walaŋ metam yabukahileeŋ yeniŋkilitilaŋ, kaŋ nu welesiloŋge wendoktiŋa welene kulemaune nadifo wapum tilat.
Kwanai me Onesimas’walaŋ mede
Nu Kilisto wou foloŋ yofafaŋeeŋ titiŋ didimeniŋ niŋ ganimbene titiŋdok kedem lodaaŋ ganindok nadilat,

iŋgoŋ oŋ, nu welesiloŋ doktiŋa mede fafaŋeniŋ adi mu ganimbit. Me noli yabukahilekahile titiŋ wendi nihikiutak, doktiŋa mede kulemaŋgoŋ ganimbit. Nu Pol, nu Kilisto Jesu’walaŋ maŋiŋ mede tiŋa yohautawene nanagila buŋa yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ napmegiŋ, kaŋ yot fafaŋeniŋme unduŋ hatatdi
mihine Onesimas
momooŋ timimbeŋ
yoŋa ganinadilat. Nu yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ hatuwene adi buŋa nabuguk, kaŋ nu tubulodawene Kilisto nadisukilitimiŋ hinek tuguk. Wendoktiŋa na’niŋ mihine hinek yolat.
Koom adi kwanai momooŋgoŋ mu tigamuŋa gehitubu-loda momooŋgoŋ mu tuguk. Iŋgoŋ kobuk adi kwanai momooŋ tiŋa nihitubu-lodaluwaak.
Nu welenedi adut halune kotigoŋ kamewene du’walaŋkade bulak.
Nu Mede Momooŋ doktiŋa yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ hatiwene du’walaŋ kayoŋkoŋ titiŋdok adi kamehemimbene iŋgoŋ hatiŋa nehitubu-lodadok adi nadifo tilat.
Iŋgoŋ tiyaugene du mu nadidapmaune kahilewene nadinambune tuwot mu tibaakneŋ, doktiŋa kotigoŋ niŋkulene bulak. Ale du nu nehitubu-lodadok nadiŋa kaŋ titiŋ momooŋ i da nadidapmaaŋ kedem tibaaŋ.
Biyaku Onesimas adi nai muniniŋ-kabe bigabuguk. Woŋ adi kotigoŋ nagilune dukut hatifafaŋedok binek unduŋ tuguk.

Nai indinde adi nadimimbune kwanai-mege hogok mu tibaak. Mokoŋ. Adi yadi kwanai-mege hatibaak, iŋgoŋ kahileune menoke hinek unduŋ tibaak. Na yadi kawene notne hinek unduŋ tubune welenedi kahile hinek tilat. Du maaŋ kahile hinek tibaaŋ u agaŋ nadilat. Adi tipilapilaye kwanaiŋiŋ gineŋ titiŋŋiŋ u kanadiune momooŋ tibaak, eŋ Kilisto’walaŋkade adi kaune noke hinek unduŋ tubune welegedi kahile hinek tibaaŋ.
Du Kilisto’walaŋ kwanai gineŋkade nabune noke hinek tilak, undugoŋ Onesimas maaŋ nu nabukahilelaŋ undugoŋ kahilewaaŋ.
Tiŋa yom nenobu tibek be du’walaŋ nemek niŋ beŋa kibikoŋ mu tubu-udaneguk, kaŋ adi wou nobuniŋ hatiwek kaŋ u biŋa nu wotnene youlaaŋ.
Nu Pol, na’niŋ kohonedi mede i youtat. Ale kibikoŋ wobudok hatak u na wobaat. Tiŋa indiŋ yolat, da maaŋ nu’walaŋkade hatihatige diniŋ kibikoŋ wobudok uŋgoŋ hakamulak, iŋgoŋ fiit wendok adi mu yobit.
Unduŋ doktiŋa notne, i nadiweŋ. Wapum wou foloŋ titiŋ momooŋ u tinambeŋdok nadilat. Indi Kilisto’walaŋ me hatiyamut, doktiŋa titiŋ undiniŋ u tubune welemomooŋ nadiwaat.
Du medene i agaŋ kedem takaliwaaŋ unduŋ hinek nadiwene dapmaune pepa i youkamulat. Tiŋa Onesimasdok titiŋ timindok ganilat u du kalakapme hinek tiŋa tibaaŋ u agaŋ nadilat.
Eŋ mede nimaaŋ indiŋ yobit. Bepaŋdi ninadihik nadiŋa kotigoŋ binabune hidi’walaŋkade baat. Unduŋ doktiŋa du yokeneŋ yotmaaŋ nu wooŋ deilaatdok neeŋ tiulidokowaaŋ.
Filemondok youtumba mede kamemiŋgiŋ
Epafala adi Kilisto Jesu doktiŋa yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ noŋgoŋ hakamut, ala adi youtumba mede kamegamulak.
Eŋ mewoi kwanai noŋgoŋ tam, me Mak, Alistaka, Dima, eŋ Luk, adi maaŋ youtumba mede kamegamiiŋ.
Wapum Jesu Kilisto’walaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋdi welehik gineŋ halek.

footnotes.text: Onesimas mebi Gilik mede gineŋ adi indiŋ: kwanai momooŋ tiŋa tubulodalak.

Onesimas adi Filemon’walaŋ tipilapilaye-me tuwaŋit mokit hatiguk, iŋgoŋ mindaŋkade momooŋ wooŋ Loma yokwet wapumneŋ hatiŋa yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ foguk. Nai uŋaniŋ tipilapilaye-me undihi adi koloŋdabek foloŋ widihikumuyagiŋ doktiŋa Poldi yokulema mede i Filemondok youlimiŋguk.
